main.description: A guess at a clue's answer. No correctness field: verdicts are computed by the AppView at render time against the puzzle's answer key, so an answer-key correction can retroactively reclassify old attempts. No author field: authorship is structural, carried by whichever account's own repo the record lives in. Scoped to the author and the puzzle: one attempt per clue per account, regardless of which team(s) the account is attempting it through.

clueId.description: The opaque id of the clue, within the referenced puzzle, this attempt is answering.
